description: Tool to list GoogleAdsLinks on a property. Use when you need to retrieve Google Ads account links configured for a Google Analytics property. Supports pagination for large result sets.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing GoogleAdsLinks on a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200; higher values will be coerced to the maximum.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListGoogleAdsLinks call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters must match the call that provided the page token.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The property resource name. Format: properties/{propertyId} (e.g., properties/1234).
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsAdminPropertiesGoogleAdsLinksListRequest

name: list_google_ads_links

googleAdsLinks.description: List of Google Ads links configured on the property.
googleAdsLinks.title: Google Ads Links

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. If omitted, there are no subsequent pages.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

canManageClients.description: Output only. Indicates if this link is managed by Google.
canManageClients.title: Can Manage Clients

createTime.description: Output only. Time when the link was originally created (RFC 3339 datetime format).
createTime.title: Create Time

customerId.description: Immutable. Google Ads customer ID formatted as a ten-digit number without hyphens.
customerId.title: Customer Id

emailAddress.description: User-provided name for the link. Must not conflict with other links.
emailAddress.title: Email Address

updateTime.description: Output only. Time when the link was last updated (RFC 3339 datetime format).
updateTime.title: Update Time
